cubby.title: The Little Pine Cubby
body: The Little Pine Cubby is our roadside stand in Pine Grove, Norfolk County, stocked with sensory kits, play boxes and a little bit of magic.
Stop by to browse what's fresh, or contact us ahead of time and we'll set aside something special.

details.text: Self-serve stand, stocked with seasonal kits
Contact us for directions and current hours

cubby.imageAlt: Illustrated sign for the Little Pine Cubby, a game stand for sensory play and magic

items.question: How do I order from Little Pine Play?
items.answer: Email us with the kit you'd like and we'll confirm availability, price and pickup or delivery. You can also buy in person at the Little Pine Cubby in Pine Grove, Norfolk County.

items.question: What are your toys and kits made from?
items.answer: Our play boxes and peg dolls are made from wood and painted by hand. Sensory kits use dyed dry goods like rice, chickpeas and pasta, with natural materials such as shells and stones wherever we can.

items.question: What ages are the kits for?
items.answer: Most kits are designed for ages 3 and up, with adult supervision. Many contain small parts and are not suitable for children under 3.

items.question: Do you make party favour kits and bulk orders?
items.answer: Yes. We make themed party favour kits and take bulk orders for classrooms, daycares and events. Contact us with your date, theme and quantity.

items.question: Can I request a custom theme?
items.answer: Absolutely. Tell us the story, character or colours you have in mind and we'll create a custom play box or sensory kit to match.

cta.title: Have something magical in mind?
cta.body: Tell us about your little one, your party or your classroom, and we'll help you pick or create the perfect kit.
